name: Lay the restless dead

beats.line: The Party reads the old names on the stones, to learn whom it must lay to rest.
The dead rise from their graves, and the churchyard is held against them.
A narrow stair leads down to the crypt, and the way is old and unsafe.
A restless power stirs in the crypt and bars the way to the last rite.

finaleLine: The last rite is spoken over the dead, and they rest.
